---
# render_farm_nodes: GPU render nodes for the render farm workshop

- name: Show the target region
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "Deploying {{ guid }} to {{ aws_region }}"

- name: Launch the render nodes
  amazon.aws.ec2_instance:
    region: "{{ aws_region }}"
    image_id: ami-0c7d41e9b25f83a16    # RHEL 9 render image
    instance_type: "{{ render_farm_node_type }}"
    count: "{{ render_farm_node_count }}"
    key_name: "{{ guid }}-key"
    vpc_subnet_id: "{{ render_farm_subnet_id }}"
    tags:
      guid: "{{ guid }}"
      lab_role: render-node
    wait: true
  register: r_render_nodes

- name: Wait for the render nodes to pass status checks
  amazon.aws.ec2_instance_info:
    region: "{{ aws_region }}"
    instance_ids: "{{ r_render_nodes.instance_ids }}"
  register: r_render_info
  until: r_render_info.instances | map(attribute='state.name') | unique == ['running']
  retries: 30
  delay: 10
